title: TerVIS
blurb: TerVIS performs TensorFlow-based vision and audio analysis for identifying terrestrial species, providing frame-by-frame recognition and pattern detection for biodiversity datasets.
description: TerVIS is a terrestrial biodiversity media-analysis system built around image recognition, frame-by-frame video analysis, webcam observation, motion-pattern detection, and bioacoustic feature extraction. The native project uses TensorFlow, OpenCV, FFmpeg, and Python. The browser port replaces native GUI/media dependencies with HTML5 media APIs, Canvas, Web Audio, and TensorFlow.js while preserving the core analysis workflow wherever browser APIs permit.
author: ZZX-Labs R&D

capabilities.name: Local image loading
capabilities.notes: Images are loaded with browser File APIs and processed locally.

capabilities.name: General image classification
capabilities.notes: MobileNet can be loaded on demand through TensorFlow.js.

capabilities.name: Custom terrestrial species model
capabilities.notes: Compatible TensorFlow.js Layers or Graph models can be loaded from model.json.

capabilities.name: Local video playback
capabilities.notes: HTML5 video decoding replaces the native FFmpeg/OpenCV display path.

capabilities.name: Frame-by-frame video analysis
capabilities.notes: Canvas frame sampling, motion scoring, periodic inference, and event logging.

capabilities.name: Live webcam analysis
capabilities.notes: Uses getUserMedia with explicit user permission.

capabilities.name: Motion-pattern detection
capabilities.notes: Downsampled grayscale frame differencing with configurable thresholds.

capabilities.name: Local audio decoding
capabilities.notes: Web Audio API decodes user-selected audio files locally.

capabilities.name: Bioacoustic feature extraction
capabilities.notes: RMS energy, zero-crossing rate, spectral centroid, and spectrum visualization.

capabilities.name: Species audio classification
capabilities.notes: Requires a compatible trained TensorFlow.js audio model; generic audio features work without one.

capabilities.name: Observation session logging
capabilities.notes: Image, video, camera, and audio observations are retained in the current browser session.

capabilities.name: JSON export
capabilities.notes: Session observations can be exported as JSON.

capabilities.name: CSV export
capabilities.notes: Session observations can be exported as CSV.

capabilities.name: Native OpenCV pipeline
capabilities.notes: Canvas and browser media APIs reproduce the major analysis path but not every OpenCV operator.

capabilities.name: Native FFmpeg pipeline
capabilities.notes: Browser media decoders are used in the static demo; exact FFmpeg codec/filter parity is not claimed.
